label: Freelance tax set-aside
why_this_fixture: A saturated fintech category with a house style of its own ("effortless", "stress-free", "take control of your finances"). The hardest test for genericity: a weak model will produce three variations of the same reassuring money app.

problem.statement: Freelance designers spend the tax they owe because it sits in the same account as everything else
problem.importance: The bill arrives once a year and is large enough to end a freelance career

primary: Freelance designers and illustrators in their first three years
needs: Knowing what is actually theirs to spend
pain_points: The tax bill is a shock every January
Bookkeeping feels like admin they did not sign up for

product.description: A tool that watches incoming invoice payments and moves the tax share into a separate pot automatically
features: Sets aside a percentage per payment

assumptions: Users are sole traders, not limited companies
